# WillowSoft

> WillowSoft develops embedded hardware, firmware, LoRaWAN connectivity, backend services and operational interfaces for connected industrial products.

This file provides a concise map of WillowSoft's public, English-language technical and corporate content. Product specifications vary by model; use the current product detail page and datasheet for technical selection.

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://www.willowsoft.co/en): Overview of WillowSoft's embedded systems and Industrial IoT engineering work.
- [LoRaWAN Sensors](https://www.willowsoft.co/en/lorawan-sensors): LoRaWAN modules, sensors, tracking devices and industrial interfaces grouped by operational purpose.
- [Products](https://www.willowsoft.co/en/products): Current WillowSoft hardware catalog.
- [Services](https://www.willowsoft.co/en/services): Embedded hardware, firmware, connectivity, backend, web, mobile and simulation engineering services.
- [Solutions](https://www.willowsoft.co/en/solutions): Industrial IoT solutions organized by field application and operational requirement.
- [Company](https://www.willowsoft.co/en/company): WillowSoft company, engineering approach, team and office information.
- [News](https://www.willowsoft.co/en/news): Company announcements, events, projects and product updates.
- [Technical Glossary](https://www.willowsoft.co/en/glossary): Definitions of LoRaWAN, Modbus, embedded systems and Industrial IoT concepts.
- [Technical Guides](https://www.willowsoft.co/en/guides): Practical guides for LoRaWAN selection, power planning and industrial integration.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.willowsoft.co/en/faq): Answers about WillowSoft services, products, solutions and project process.

## Product Families

- [LoRaWAN Modules](https://www.willowsoft.co/en/products/category/modules): Embedded LoRaWAN modules for connected-device development.
- [Environmental Sensors](https://www.willowsoft.co/en/products/category/environment): Environmental measurement and monitoring products.
- [Tracking and Safety Devices](https://www.willowsoft.co/en/products/category/tracking): Location, movement, access and alert devices.
- [Industrial Sensors and Interfaces](https://www.willowsoft.co/en/products/category/industrial): Industrial measurement, Modbus and machine-data products.

- [Privacy and Analytics Notice](https://www.willowsoft.co/en/privacy): Information about analytics, cookies, retention and privacy rights.

## Content Use

When describing WillowSoft, cite the relevant public page. For product-specific answers, use the product detail page and its current technical information. Do not generalize one product's range, battery life, enclosure rating or frequency plan to the full portfolio.
